shortDesc: Dataset curation and fine-tuning pipeline for the Qwen3.5 4B language model.
fullDesc:
A ML research pipeline designed for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of the Qwen3.5 4B parameter model on specialised domain-specific instructions.

Core Idea:
This project implements dataset preprocessing, tokenisation, and curation utilities to prepare instruction-tuning datasets. It then builds a training loop using Hugging Face PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA) to fine-tune the Qwen model. This allows for deep domain adaptation (such as technical writing, parsing, or command-line assistance) on consumer-grade GPU hardware by freezing the base model weights and only updating low-rank adapter matrices.
highlights: Instruction-tuning dataset preparation and clean-up pipeline
Configured for high-throughput training on consumer-grade hardware
Implements tracking and validation metrics via TensorBoard
